description: Hierarchical role system with reporting lines, goal cascading, and role-based skill assignment. Unlike Paperclip's generic company metaphor, XRoads roles are deeply integrated with code awareness — each role understands repos, files, branches, and PRDs natively.
goals: Hierarchical role system with goal cascading and reporting lines
Roles deeply tied to code-aware orchestration (not just task assignment)
Chairman becomes CEO — all existing cockpit logic upgraded
Visual org chart in UI with live status per node
non_goals: No generic business roles (marketing, sales) — XRoads is code-first
No separate role for non-coding tasks — everything maps to code operations

OrgRole.description: A role in the orchestration hierarchy — maps to a slot or virtual supervisor

fields.name: String — e.g. 'Tech Lead', 'Backend Engineer', 'QA Lead'
fields.roleType: RoleType enum — ceo, lead, engineer, reviewer, qa
fields.parentRoleId: UUID? FK OrgRole — reporting line (null = root/CEO)
fields.assignedSlotId: UUID? FK AgentSlot — physical slot assignment
fields.skillNames: JSON String[] — required skills for this role

user_stories.title: OrgRole entity + DB migration
user_stories.description: Create org_role table (v9 migration). Fields: id, sessionId, name, roleType, parentRoleId (self-referencing FK), assignedSlotId, goalDescription, skillNames (JSON), authority, timestamps. Index on sessionId, parentRoleId. Constraint: max 1 CEO per session. CRUD repo with tree traversal queries (get_subtree, get_ancestors, get_siblings).
tests: org_role table created with self-referencing FK
cascade delete removes children when parent deleted

user_stories.title: Role template system
user_stories.description: Pre-built role templates for common team structures. Templates: Solo Dev (1 role), Duo (lead + engineer), Squad (lead + 2 engineers + QA), Full Team (CEO/architect + 2 leads + 3 engineers + reviewer). Each template defines: role names, types, hierarchy, default skills, authority levels. Templates stored as JSON in bundled resources. Custom template creation + save. Template auto-populates org chart on session activation.
tests: Squad template creates 4 roles with correct hierarchy
template populates org chart on activate

user_stories.title: Goal cascading engine
user_stories.description: CEO goal = session-level objective (e.g. 'Implement auth system'). Leads decompose into sub-goals (e.g. 'Backend API', 'Frontend forms', 'Tests'). Engineers receive atomic goals mapped to PRD stories. Goal flow: CEO.goal → Lead.goal → Engineer.goal. Chairman deliberation (PRD-18) now uses org chart to distribute goals instead of flat slot assignment. Goals persist in OrgRole.goalDescription. Goal completion bubbles up — when all children complete, parent auto-completes.
tests: lead goals map to PRD stories for engineers
chairman uses org chart for delegation

user_stories.title: Authority-based gate routing
user_stories.description: When a SafeExecutor gate fires, route approval based on authority hierarchy. Low/medium risk: auto-approved if role has 'full' authority. High risk: escalate to parent role (lead approves engineer's dangerous op). Critical risk: escalate to CEO/root role. Authority inheritance: child roles inherit parent's approval unless overridden. This replaces flat 'require_human_approval' with org-aware routing. If no parent available, fall back to human approval.
tests: low risk auto-approved by full-authority role
high risk escalated to parent lead
no parent falls back to human

user_stories.title: Org chart UI component
user_stories.description: Visual tree rendering of org hierarchy in cockpit panel. Each node shows: role name, agent type icon, slot status badge, current task, cost badge. Connections: solid lines for active reporting, dashed for inactive. Node colors match agent type (claude green, gemini blue, codex purple). Click node to expand slot details. Drag-and-drop to reassign slots between roles. Real-time status updates via event bus. Collapse/expand subtrees.

user_stories.title: Inter-role communication channels
user_stories.description: Typed message channels between roles based on hierarchy. Channels: report_up (child → parent status update), delegate_down (parent → child task assignment), peer (sibling → sibling coordination), broadcast (CEO → all). Messages route via existing AgentMessage but with new MessageType values: 'delegation', 'report', 'peer_request', 'escalation'. Role-aware message filtering in chat panel. Automatic status reports: each role sends progress report to parent every N iterations.
tests: auto status report sent on iteration
